evidence: Deletes custom in-tree polyfills in src/util/expected.h, src/compat/byteswap.h, and src/util/types.h in favor of C++23 standard library equivalents.
rationale: Retires custom in-tree utility polyfills like util::Expected and byteswap in favor of standard library counterparts. While beneficial for codebase simplicity, retiring these internal wrappers is an incremental maintenance improvement rather than a critical reliability fix.
